title: E2E specs that seed the extension IndexedDB via service-worker evaluate rot silently when DB_SCHEMA_VERSION bumps — read the live version via indexedDB.databases() instead of a pinned constant
trigger: An e2e seed helper calls indexedDB.open(dbName, PINNED_VERSION) inside a Playwright service-worker evaluate and the repository DB_SCHEMA_VERSION has moved past the pin
principle: indexedDB.open(name, v) throws VersionError when the existing DB is newer. A pinned DB_SCHEMA_VERSION constant in the spec is a hidden version pin that goes stale every schema bump. Resolve the live version first (`indexedDB.databases()` → find by name → use its version when higher), keep the upgradeneeded guards so a fresh DB still gets all stores, and bump the pin as the floor.

cases.context: lookup-hot-path ship: dictionary-nested-popup.spec.ts pinned version 12 while the repo was at 13 — one test passed before the DB existed, the second failed VersionError on the same run because the extension had already created v13.
cases.good: const existing = (await indexedDB.databases()).find(d => d.name === dbName); const version = Math.max(DB_SCHEMA_VERSION, existing?.version ?? 0); indexedDB.open(dbName, version)

applyFor: any e2e/stage2 spec that writes directly into orca-dict-* or other extension IDB databases
helpers that seed IndexedDB outside application code
